name: The mile and a half
prompt: The fitness standard is a mile and a half in under fifteen minutes, in the cold, at seven in the morning.

choices.text: Run it even, lap by lap

outcome.told: You finish with half a minute to spare and nothing left over.

choices.text: Go out hard and hold on

outcome.told: Fourteen minutes and ten seconds. Your lungs burn through roll call.

failure.told: You fade on the last lap and come in over. It goes in your file as a fail to be retaken.
